actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.name: seed

facts.text: Home-v0 is registered with entry point home_platform.gym.envs:HomeEnv, max_episode_steps 1000 and reward_threshold 0.0
The action has two components, moving and looking, each a Discrete 5 action 0 to 4 (NOOP, UP, RIGHT, DOWN, LEFT)
The constructor defaults turning_speed to 0.1 and moving_speed to 100
The action space is constructed as spaces.MultiDiscrete([[0, 4], [0, 4]])
The observation is a Dict: position and orientation of 3 values each in -100 to 100, an image of 500 x 500 x 3 values in 0 to 255, and a collision flag of 0 or 1
Each step applies moving then looking, advances the environment one step, and returns the observation with reward 0, done False and misc None
Looking action 1 subtracts turning_speed from heading, 2 adds it to roll, 3 adds it to heading and 4 subtracts it from roll
Moving action 1 applies a +moving_speed impulse on y, 2 +x on x, 3 -y on y and 4 -x on x
A reset places the agent at (42, -39, 1) with orientation (0, 0, 0), advances the environment once, increments the house index and wraps it at the end of the list
The clone ships one house id (list_of_houses) and _seed asserts seed < len(list_of_houses), so the only valid house index is 0
BasicEnvironment defaults its integration interval dt to 0.1 seconds
BasicEnvironment.step advances the physics and render worlds by dt, which is the configured 0.1 s unless realtime is set
The agent is a Bullet capsule of radius 0.1, height 1.6 and mass 60.0

determinism.notes: the simulation has no random source: a reset returns the fixed start pose and a seed selects the house index; the clone ships one house, so upstream only accepts seed 0

gaps: no rigid-body dynamics: the fake moves the agent kinematically on the horizontal plane, with no Bullet contacts, friction, gravity, collision detection, renderer or sensor/noise model
the collision flag is always 0 and the image is a constant 4 x 4 x 3 frame; the upstream image is 500 x 500 x 3 (home_env_basic.py:57)
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms (dt 0.1 s) only
the fake does not add the 1000-step TimeLimit that gym.make('Home-v0') adds from the registration (home_platform/gym/__init__.py:6); done is always False as in HomeEnv._step
snapshot and restore are not offered: HomeEnv exposes no get_state/set_state
the upstream package is Python 2 / Panda3D and was not imported or run; the fake was not compared with the upstream environment
the upstream action-space constructor spaces.MultiDiscrete([[0, 4], [0, 4]]) does not match the documented two 0-4 components; the fake implements the documented two-component action

the upstream _seed asserts seed < len(list_of_houses) (home_env_basic.py:85); the fake maps any non-negative seed to the only house so the generic cap.world.seed.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 contract stays usable, and the upstream path would refuse a seed above 0

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
